## Key Takeaways


- Parsons partners with Al Basateen to manage the King’s Square Project in Riyadh, which spans 32 months.
- The project includes planning, design, and oversight of 16 mixed-use buildings with a total area of 261,000 square meters.
- Parsons aims to deliver world-class project management, ensuring quality and safety across all phases of the project.
- Al Basateen emphasizes the importance of Parsons’ technical expertise and track record in completing complex projects in Saudi Arabia.
- With over 65 years in the Kingdom, Parsons manages over 50 active projects focusing on urban development, sustainability, and safety.


**We’re partnering with Al Basateen, a Saudi Arabian real estate company specializing in residential and commercial projects, to provide project management, supervision and technical review services for the King’s Square Project in Riyadh. This 32 month contract represents new work for us.** **** **** **** **** ****


Under the contract, we will oversee planning, design and construction supervision, technical assurance, and delivery oversight across Phases 1, 2, and 3 of the development, supporting the client’s long-term vision for delivering modern, sustainable real estate assets and community infrastructure. Located in the King Fahad and King Salman intersection, the project is comprised of 16 buildings including towers, podiums and courtyards, and will combine residential, office and commercial spaces with a total built up area of 261,000 square meters.


“Parsons is proud to partner with Al Basateen on this landmark, multi-phase mixed-use development in Riyadh,” said Pierre Santoni, President, Infrastructure EMEA at Parsons. “This dynamic project underscores Parsons’ expertise in global urban development and brings together advanced technologies and innovative design to foster connected, future-ready communities and redefine the smart living experience for residents and visitors alike. Drawing on more than 80 years of global expertise, our team will deliver world-class project management under the highest international quality and safety standards ensuring seamless execution and long-term value.”


“Kings’ Square is a landmark development for Al Basateen and a statement of our ambition in Riyadh’s evolving urban landscape, and its delivery demands a project management partner with proven capability across complex, multi-phase mixed-use programs,” said the representative from Al Basateen Real Estate Co. “We selected Parsons for its depth of technical expertise, its established track record in the Kingdom, and its ability to bring international standards of project controls, technical assurance, and supervision to every stage of delivery. We expect this partnership to reinforce disciplined execution, safeguard quality and safety across all phases, and ensure that Kings’ Square is delivered to the standard our stakeholders and the city of Riyadh deserve.”


We have been a trusted partner in delivering projects in Saudi Arabia for over 65 years and currently have more than 50 active projects in the Kingdom – including mega and giga projects.
